title: İş hayatı: put off, call off, take over
explain_tr: Phrasal verb = fiil + küçük kelime (off, up, over, out…). Anlam çoğu zaman parçalardan tahmin edilemez, **kalıp olarak** öğrenilmelidir.

**put off** = *ertelemek* (olay yine olacak, sadece daha sonra): *We **put off** the meeting until Friday.* **call off** = *iptal etmek* (olay hiç olmayacak): *They **called off** the match because of the snow.* Türkçede *"toplantıyı kaldırdılar"* hem erteleme hem iptal olabilir; İngilizcede ayrımı mutlaka yap.
**take over** = *(bir işin/şirketin) yönetimini devralmak*: *Ayşe will **take over** the project when I leave.* / *A big company **took over** our firm.*

Diğer iş kalıpları: **set up** (kurmak: set up a company / a meeting), **carry on** (devam etmek: carry on working), **hand in** (teslim etmek: hand in a report), **fill in** (form doldurmak), **run out of** (tükenmek: We've run out of paper).

Nesne zamirse (it, them, him) **ortaya** girer: *put **it** off* ✓, *put off it* ✗. İsimse iki yer de olur: *put off the meeting* = *put the meeting off*. Bir fiilden sonra -ing gelir: *Stop **putting off** studying!*
explain_en: put off = postpone; call off = cancel; take over = take control/responsibility of something.
With separable phrasal verbs, pronouns go between the verb and the particle: put it off, call it off.
table: They **put off** the launch until June.

pairs.wrong: The concert was put off. It will never happen.
pairs.right: The concert was called off. It will never happen.

pairs.wrong: Let's call off the meeting until next week.
pairs.right: Let's put off the meeting until next week.

pairs.wrong: Who will take on the company after the CEO retires?
pairs.right: Who will take over the company after the CEO retires?

exercises.prompt: The football match was ___ off because of heavy rain. It won't be played at all.
Can we ___ off the meeting until Thursday? I'm not ready.
When the manager left, Kemal ___ over his responsibilities.
We have run ___ of printer paper. Can you order some?
Please hand ___ your reports before Friday.

options: They called off the wedding because of the rain.
They put off the wedding because of the rain.
They took over the wedding because of the rain.
They set up the wedding because of the rain.
answer: They put off the wedding because of the rain.

exercises.prompt: A big Chinese company bought our company and now controls it. It ___.
exercises.explain_tr: Bir şirketin kontrolünü almak → take over.

exercises.prompt: The strike was put off, so the workers never stopped working.
answer: The strike was called off, so the workers never stopped working.

exercises.prompt: I always put off to do my homework.
answer: I always put off doing my homework.

exercises.prompt: The printer isn't working, so we have to put off it until tomorrow.
answer: The printer isn't working, so we have to put it off until tomorrow.

exercises.prompt: Let's take a short break and then carry on to work.
answer: Let's take a short break and then carry on working.

exercises.prompt:
put off ile yeniden yaz:
We postponed the trip to next month.
answer: We put off the trip to next month.
We put off the trip until next month.
We put the trip off to next month.
We put the trip off until next month.

exercises.prompt:
call off ve zamir (it) ile yeniden yaz:
They cancelled the party.
exercises.explain_tr: cancel = call off; zamir ortaya: called **it** off.
